findings.title: Discernment tested in conduct
findings.claim: The focus can be read as inward discernment placed under a wider behavioral assay: clear-sighted capacity is shown beside truthful conduct, made deeds, and judgment, while the focus report of diversion remains intact.
findings.mechanism: The exact Arabic sequence at 29:2-4 moves from an untested claim through testing and truth-verification to made deeds and faulty judgment; the HFT trace returns that sequence through the focus carriers.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing capacity becomes newly legible as something whose practical force is examined in motion, rather than a label that would make diversion impossible.
findings.containment: This is a qualified contextual inference from a legacy-unbound trace. It does not decide between worldly competence and moral discernment, and the ordinary historical claim remains recoverable.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic anchors and typed focus carriers are present, but the HFT relation and context branch details remain attributed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, kalpte nüfuz eden kavrayış ve doğrulanmış anlayış çekirdektir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider sequence joins an untested claim to assay, enacted truth, made deeds, and judgment.
branch_activations.activation: The focus capacity meets the wider assay sequence, so its presence is read through what conduct proves or fails to prove.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Their discernment can be real yet remain under examination when beautified deeds and judgment disclose practical failure.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the facet is the only sense of the focus participle or that the context branches have typed morphology.

branch_activations.boundary: This does not identify every deed as evil or make the wider polemic a complete explanation of the focus.

findings.title: A sponsored rival route
findings.claim: The focus path-blocking can also be read against a socially sponsored rival route whose appeal includes the fiction that someone else can absorb its consequences.
findings.mechanism: 29:12 invites people to follow a possessive rival path and promises burden transfer; 29:13 reverses that promise into personal and additional loads, returning path and turning-away meanings to the focus.
findings.reader_payoff: Diversion becomes newly perceptible as recruitment onto an offered route, with reassurance about consequences helping the route gain force.
findings.containment: The focus still says that the named people were turned away from the recognized path. Recruitment and burden transfer are qualified inferences, and unresolved context branches remain excluded.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic context anchors and typed focus branches are supplied, while the HFT causal arrow and context branch records remain attributed or unresolved.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Path-blocking can include recruitment into a route whose apparent protection makes its obstruction persuasive.

findings.containment: This does not make the focus term ironic by definition. The packet leaves open that the answers are polemical admissions rather than stable cognition, and unresolved context branches are not lexical facts.

epistemic.reason: Focus branches and exact Arabic anchors are supplied, but the nonbinding relation is an HFT inference and most context branches are unresolved.

findings.containment: The ordinary focus meaning that they were in a discerning state remains intact. The state-switch is an attributed inference, while the alternative remains rhetorical inconsistency rather than a psychological model.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic context and typed focus carriers support the changed-state reading, but its psychological mechanism is an HFT inference.

findings.title: A recurring beautification-to-diversion pairing
findings.claim: Across wider passages, making deeds attractive and turning people from the path recur as a paired operation; in 29:38 that recurrence meets the added fact of discernment.
findings.mechanism: The exact target Arabic at 27:24 repeats the focus sequence, while 16:63, 47:14, and 47:25 place beautified work beside evidence, desire, or return after guidance; connection records return these relations through the focus verbs and path noun.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus conjunction becomes newly legible as a recurring operation rather than an isolated local association, while the final discernment clause remains a live tension.
findings.containment: The connection rows provide exact target Arabic but no target morphology or source-trust label, so this is qualified connection-level recognition. Recurrence does not prove a universal causal law or erase the ordinary focus report.

epistemic.reason: Target Arabic and connection records are supplied, but target morphology and an explicit trust label are absent; prior retrieval labels are not decisions.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey güzelleştirilir veya onda bulunan güzellik eylem ya da söz yoluyla görünür hale getirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries making deeds appear attractive or beautiful.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider target Arabic repeats or contrasts beautification of work in relation to guidance, evidence, and return.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated target operation meets the focus beautification verb and makes its adjacency to diversion a recurrent relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus beautification is newly heard as part of a wider beautification-to-diversion pattern, with discernment still present here.
branch_activations.boundary: Connection targets lack typed morphology; recurrence does not claim that every beautification instance has the focus path result.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Özne, yöneldiği şeyden yüz çevirir, uzaklaşır veya ona katılmaktan kaçınır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries turning away from a direction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 27:24 supplies the same beautification sequence followed by turning from the path.
branch_activations.activation: The exact repeated sequence meets the focus turning-away verb and binds the consequence to beautification.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus path result is newly visible as a recurring consequence paired with attractive presentation of deeds.
branch_activations.boundary: Target morphology is absent, and recurrence does not decide why any individual turns away.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yol ve bir amaca ulaştıran yol
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanların üzerinde yürüyüp ilerlediği uzanmış yol veya yolları belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries the traversed path from which people are turned.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 27:24 repeats the path noun directly after the beautification and turning-away sequence.
branch_activations.activation: The exact path recurrence meets the focus definite route and makes the operation a recognizable wider pairing.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The singular focus route is linked to a repeated pattern in which attractive deeds accompany loss of direction.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection supplies no target morphology and does not make the path noun a metaphor or universal explanation.

findings.title: Ruined sites as recurring evidence
findings.claim: Across wider passages, former dwellings and ruined sites repeatedly function as visible signs, making the focus dwellings an evidentiary surface rather than historical scenery alone.
findings.mechanism: Connection targets at 20:128, 32:26, 46:25, 22:45, and 15:82 join walking or seeing with destroyed or carved dwellings and signs; those relations return through the focus disclosure and dwelling carriers.
findings.reader_payoff: The phrase from their dwellings becomes concrete as an invitation to meet a visible residue whose placement in the landscape carries the warning.
findings.containment: The focus still states that the dwellings made the outcome clear. Connection rows supply target Arabic without target morphology or trust labels, and recurrence does not determine the meaning of every ruin.

epistemic.reason: Several exact inter-surah target rows support the recurring relation, but their target morphology and explicit trust labels are absent.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries disclosure that makes an outcome visible and clear.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Wider rows repeatedly describe people walking among destroyed or carved dwellings and identify signs in what remains.
branch_activations.activation: The recurring site-and-sign relation meets the focus disclosure verb, making clarity arise from encountered remains.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus clarity from dwellings belongs to a wider pattern in which the landscape retains a readable consequence.
branch_activations.boundary: Targets do not supply target morphology or prove that every dwelling is a sign; the focus claim remains controlling.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sabit yer ve konum bildiren özel kullanımlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Çoğul kalıp ifadeler kişilerin yerlerini, konumlarını, düzeylerini, evlerini veya alışılmış düzenlerini gösterebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus plural noun carries fixed homes and settled locations.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Wider rows return to former people's homes, carved houses, and ruined settlement sites as things encountered on the ground.
branch_activations.activation: The fixed-place carrier meets recurring landscape evidence, so dwellings become stable coordinates for reading what happened.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Their homes are surviving locations through which a past outcome remains present to observers.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses the qualified F002 contextual facet and does not claim that material remains alone settle all interpretation.

findings.title: Capacity beside guidance and refusal
findings.claim: Wider passages repeatedly place sight or inward capacity beside guidance and its refusal, so the focus can retain a capacity reading while the path result remains adverse.
findings.mechanism: Targets at 41:17, 46:26, 22:46, 7:146, and 45:20 pair guidance, sight, hearts, signs, or their failure; connection records return those relations through the focus word's bodily-seeing and inward-discernment options.
findings.reader_payoff: The final word is newly heard as a capacity that can be present on either side of orientation, leaving the focus paradox intelligible without selecting a facet.
findings.containment: Connection rows supply exact target Arabic but no target morphology or explicit trust label, and they do not decide between visual and inward facets. The ordinary focus statement and both capacity possibilities remain recoverable.

epistemic.reason: Target Arabic and relation notes are supplied, but target lexical analyses and trust labels are absent; the facet pairing remains qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Görme duyusu, bakan göz organı ve bir şeyi gözle görme eylemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus participle can carry bodily seeing and perceptual capacity.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Wider targets place eyes or seeing beside failed benefit, heart blindness, or seeing signs without taking the right path.
branch_activations.activation: The visual capacity option meets targets where seeing remains present while orientation fails.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus can hold perceptual capacity alongside the adverse path result without requiring physical blindness.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not suppress the inward-discernment option, and targets do not supply morphology proving a single lexical choice.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, kalpte nüfuz eden kavrayış ve doğrulanmış anlayış çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus participle can carry inward understanding and heart-level discernment.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Wider targets show guidance chosen or refused, faculties failing to benefit, signs seen without the right path, and basira paired with guidance.
branch_activations.activation: The inward capacity option meets positive and adverse targets, making capacity distinct from its orientation and use.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus can describe discernment whose relation to guidance remains a live question rather than a missing faculty.
branch_activations.boundary: Connection evidence does not rank positive and adverse cases or prove that the focus selects this facet over bodily seeing.

findings.title: Path obstruction as public action
findings.claim: Across wider passages, being turned from the path recurs as a concrete social operation involving public value, authority, protective-looking speech, and practices that obstruct other people's movement.
findings.mechanism: Targets at 9:9, 16:88, 47:32, 63:2, 9:34, and 5:91 describe public or institutional actions that block the path through exchange, authority, shields, or practices; these relations return through the focus turning-away verb and route noun.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus phrase becomes newly capable of showing obstruction with social reach, not only a private change of direction.
findings.containment: The focus still states that the named peoples were turned away from the recognized path. Connection rows lack target morphology and trust labels and do not prove that every focus instance expands into public obstruction.

epistemic.reason: Exact target Arabic and connection notes supply recurring social forms, but target lexical analysis and an explicit trust label are absent.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Özne, yöneldiği şeyden yüz çevirir, uzaklaşır veya ona katılmaktan kaçınır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries turning away and barring movement from a direction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Wider rows repeatedly describe public or institutional actions that turn people away from the path.
branch_activations.activation: Social forms meet the focus turning-away carrier, extending its consequence from orientation to public obstruction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus turning-away can be perceived as an operation enacted through social structures and practices.
branch_activations.boundary: Connection rows do not supply target morphology or prove that the focus people perform each listed social form.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yol ve bir amaca ulaştıran yol
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanların üzerinde yürüyüp ilerlediği uzanmış yol veya yolları belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries the route or course toward an end.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Wider targets repeatedly name the path as something institutions or practices can block, redirect, or make costly.
branch_activations.activation: The route carrier meets repeated social obstruction, so the focus path is seen as a shared course whose access can be controlled.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The recognized path is a public route, and diversion can affect other travelers as well as the diverted people.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not turn the focus noun into a political term or treat retrieval labels as semantic proof.
